title_as_printed: Experimental data and calculated vapor pressures of CaCl2-H2O and MgCl2-H2O with fitting models (experimental VLE data at temperature T, solute mass fraction w and Pressure P, gamma_w represents activity coefficient of water)

footnotes_as_printed.a: Standard uncertainty of mass fraction u_w=0.0001. The standard uncertainties for temperature and pressure are given in the table.

pressure_note: equilibrium vapour pressure of the solution measured with a pressure transducer (full scale 200 kPa); 'vapor pressure', absolute/gauge not stated

value.what: experimental vapour pressure of the aqueous salt solution

composition.other_species: salt per block label: CaCl2 or MgCl2; w is the solute mass fraction, standard uncertainty 0.0001

extra_unmapped: gamma_w (activity coefficient of water, derived by authors from the measurement)
P_Antoine/kPa and RD_Antoine (modified Antoine fit results)
notes: Minus sign printed as en dash converted to '-'. Percent sign kept in RD columns. Rows 1-55 CaCl2 (55 points), rows 57-122 MgCl2 (66 points) in 0-based data-row indices; the P column serves as both P and value.
